findings.title: Authentication Endpoint Requires Manual Review
findings.description: Authentication endpoints should be carefully reviewed for weak credentials, account lockout mechanisms, rate limiting, and proper token validation.
findings.remediation: Implement strong password policies, account lockout after failed attempts, rate limiting, and proper token generation using industry-standard algorithms.
